model_claims.text: On Python 3.15+, urlsafe_b64decode requires proper padding and will reject inputs without it.
model_claims.source_quote: require padding when decoding base64 on Python 3.15+

model_claims.text: urlsafe_b64decode will raise BadData for malformed input lacking padding on Python 3.15+.
model_claims.source_quote: in order to fix raising `BadData` in some cases of malformed input

model_claims.text: The PR resolves the test failures in the 'bad payload' tests when using zlib-ng as the compression library.
model_claims.source_quote: This fixes the test failures in "bad payload" tests that incidentally surface when using zlib-ng as the compression library.
